**[[Arkady Babchenko]], who was reportedly assassinated yesterday in [[Kiev]], [[Ukraine]], appears on live television stating that the assassination was staged. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44307611 (BBC)]

;Business and economy
*[[2018 Brazil truck drivers' strike]]
**Oil workers in [[Brazil]] start a 72-hour strike, amid the ongoing truck drivers' strike. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-transportation/brazil-oil-workers-begin-strike-in-new-blow-to-government-idUSKCN1IV0HJ (Reuters)]
*[[Economy of the United States]]
**Amid concerns that the value of the company's [[stock]]s would fall after the decision to cease the sales of [[assault rifle|certain firearms]], [[Dick's Sporting Goods]] reports a stronger than expected quarter, with shares up 27%. [http://money.cnn.com/2018/05/30/news/companies/dicks-sporting-goods-earnings/index.html (CNN)]

;Disasters and accidents
* At least Eight people are killed after a fire tore through a boarding house in [[Surabaya]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://news.detik.com/berita-jawa-timur/d-4045491/8-korban-kebakaran-kos-yang-tewas-belum-rampung-diidentifikasi (Detik)] 
*An avalanche at [[Babusar Pass]] kills five members of [[Tablighi Jamaat]] religious organization. [http://en.dailypakistan.com.pk/pakistan/5-tableeghi-jamaat-members-buried-under-snow-on-babusar-top/ (''Daily Pakistan'')]

;Health and environment
*[[Whaling in Japan|Japanese whaling]], [[Whaling controversy]]
**A consortium led by the [[Institute of Cetacean Research]], which is linked to [[Japan]]'s [[Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (Japan)|Ministry of Fisheries]], reports that 333 [[Antarctic minke whale]]s were killed in last summer's scientific survey. 122 of the whales were pregnant, and 114 immature. [https://www.smithsonianmag.com/smart-news/japan-killed-112-pregnant-whales-name-scientific-research-180969205/ (''Smithsonian'')]

;International relations
*[[Macedonia naming dispute]]
**According to [[Prime Minister of Macedonia|Macedonian Prime Minister]] [[Zoran Zaev]], talks with [[Greece]] on [[Republic of Macedonia|Macedonia]]'s name are in a final phase. Zaev says that if a compromise name for the country is agreed upon, it will be put to a referendum. [https://www.rferl.org/a/macedonia-says-name-referendum-planned-for-autumn/29259434.html (RFE/RL)]
*[[North Korea–United States relations]], [[2018 North Korea–United States summit]]
**Top [[North Korea]]n official [[Kim Yong-chol]] meets with [[United States|U.S.]] [[United States Secretary of State|Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]] in [[New York City]] to discuss the summit set to be held in June. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-44309961 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Harvey Weinstein sexual abuse allegations]]
**[[Harvey Weinstein]] is indicted for rape charges by a [[New York City]] grand jury. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/harvey-weinsten-indicted-for-rape-in-nyc-today-2018-05-30/ (CBS)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Budget of the European Union]]
**The [[European Commission]] proposes to double funding for the [[Erasmus Programme]]. If adopted, the 2021–2027 budget for the [[Student exchange program|student exchange programme]] would be [[€]]30 billion. [https://www.trtworld.com/life/eu-plans-to-double-erasmus-student-funding-17860 (TRT World)]
*[[Net neutrality]]
**The Senate of the State of [[California]] votes to reinstate [[internet]] open-access rules. [https://www.theverge.com/2018/5/30/17406182/california-senate-net-neutrality-vote (''The Verge'')]
*[[Feminism in the United States]]
**The [[Illinois House of Representatives]] votes 72–45 to ratify the [[Equal Rights Amendment]].  [http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/local/politics/ct-met-equal-rights-amendment-illinois-20180530-story.html (''Chicago Tribune'')]
